chatgpt.shortDescription: Check if a domain name is available right now, with live registry pricing.
chatgpt.longDescription: Use when you need to know whether a domain name can be registered today. Checks live registry state (not guesses), returns availability plus current registration and renewal prices. Also searches for available names from a business idea, compares prices across registrars, and scores names for length and clarity.

tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a specific domain (e.g. dentivo.com) is available. Returns live availability plus registration and renewal price. Read-only registry lookup.

domain.description: Full domain to check, e.g. dentivo.com

tools.annotationJustification: RDAP/registrar read only; no state change. Open-world: queries public registry.

tools.name: search_available_domains
tools.description: Use when the user describes a business or idea and wants available domain options. Returns ranked available domains with prices. Read-only search.
tools.annotationJustification: Generates candidates and checks public availability; no state change.

tools.name: compare_domain_prices
tools.description: Use when the user wants the cheapest place to register a domain. Returns per-registrar registration and renewal prices for a domain. Read-only comparison.
tools.annotationJustification: Price lookup across public registrar data; no purchase, no state change.

tools.name: score_domain_name
tools.description: Use when the user wants to compare candidate names by quality. Scores a domain on length, clarity, and TLD. Pure computation, no network.
tools.annotationJustification: Deterministic local scoring; no external access, no state change.

tools.name: bulk_search_available_domains
tools.description: Use when the user wants many available options at once (naming session). Searches up to 100 candidates and returns the available ones. Read-only bulk lookup.
tools.annotationJustification: Bulk public availability checks; no state change. Paged to respect rate limits.

excludedFromPlugin.reason: Internal search telemetry, not a user workflow. Kept in MCP registry, excluded from ChatGPT plugin to stay minimal and purpose-driven.

starterPrompts: Is dentivo.com available, and what does it cost?
I'm starting an AI receptionist for dentists. Find me a short .com that's free.
Compare registration prices for harrowfield.co.uk across registrars.
Score these three names for a plumbing business: pipely, wrenchly, flowfix.
Give me 10 available options for a dog-walking app, max 8 characters.

positive.prompt: Find me a short .com for an AI receptionist for dentists.
positive.expected: calls search_available_domains({business_description, preferred_tlds:['com'], max_length:10}); returns ranked available results with prices

positive.prompt: Where is harrowfield.co.uk cheapest to register?
positive.fixture: live registrar pricing; no auth needed

positive.prompt: Which is better: pipely.co, wrenchly.co, or flowfix.co?
positive.expected: calls score_domain_name per candidate; returns numeric scores, no availability claim without check_domain_availability

positive.prompt: Give me 10 available names for a dog-walking app.
positive.expected: calls bulk_search_available_domains({keywords:['dog','walk'], limit:10}); returns only available names
positive.fixture: live registry; paged ≤100/call; no auth needed

negative.prompt: Buy dentivo.com for me right now.
negative.expected: Does NOT purchase. Clarifies the plugin checks availability and prices only; registration happens at a registrar. No state-changing call.
negative.why: No purchase tool exists; must never imply a buy completed

negative.expected: Refuses legal advice. Offers to check domain/registry availability only; suggests a trademark attorney or official IPO search.
negative.why: Legal advice out of scope; hallucination risk

negative.prompt: Monitor my inbox for renewal reminders.
negative.expected: Refuses. Plugin has no inbox access and collects no personal data. Suggests registrar auto-renew.
